}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== The AKiTiO Thunder2 10G Network Adapter was a bus-powered Thunderbolt 2 to 10G Ethernet adapter. It was designed for notebooks, such as the Apple® MacBook Pro, MacBook AIR and professional workstations that require reliable, accelerated access to external storage and networks for I/O demanding applications.
